sheets.name: LoanStatusDefinitions
rows: This tab provides definitions for the Portfolio by Loan Status reports.
Data Source: National Student Loan Data System

Data Run Date: Data is run at the end of each quarter listed by federal fiscal year. Each federal fiscal year begins October 1 and ends September 30. Q1 ends 12/31, Q2 ends 3/31, Q3 ends 6/30, and Q4 ends 9/30.
Please Note: Recipient counts are based at the loan level. As a result, recipients may be counted multiple times across varying loan statuses.
Includes loans that have never entered repayment as a result of the borrower's enrollment in school.
Includes loans that have entered a six-month grace period after the borrower is no longer enrolled in school at least half-time. Borrowers are not expected to make payments during grace.
Includes loans that are in an active repayment status.
Includes loans in which payments have been postponed as a result of certain circumstances such as returning to school, military service, or economic hardship.
Includes loans in which payments have been temporary suspended or reduced as a result of certain types of financial hardships.
Includes loans that are more than 360 days delinquent.
Includes loans that are in non-defaulted bankruptcy and in a disability status.
Includes the outstanding principal and interest balance of loans in the specified status.

Includes the number of recipients in the specified loan status.  The recipient is the student that benefits from the federal student loan. In most cases, the recipient is the borrower, but in parent PLUS loans, the parent is the borrower and their child is the recipient.
